name: auto-research

plugins.name: auto-research
plugins.description: End-to-end auto-research factory (ideation -> pick ONE seed with venue+notes -> experiment+review LOOP -> ship + FINAL-REPORT) gluing vendored arxiv-recommender + paper-polishing via a thin L0 state machine.

plugins.name: arxiv-recommender-ar
plugins.description: Weekly personalized arXiv paper recommender. Mechanical PREFETCH (SPECTER2 + BM25 + citation, RRF-fused) feeds Claude as the native reranker; a claim/repo judge gate picks survivors; the verified-kill ideation loop (generate → screen → verify with EXECUTED probes → recheck + refutation hunt, death-certificate regeneration) ships at most one verification-hardened /research-ready plan per paper. Single entry point: /arxiv-scout-beta.

plugins.name: paper-polish-ar
plugins.description: Polish a correct AI-generated paper draft into publishable, human-sounding prose without touching the science. Freezes data/claims/citations; rewrites wording, structure, and flow toward top-journal quality. A config-driven JS workflow spawns a goal-driven reviser + read-only reviewers that retrieve task-neutral capability skills at runtime (fidelity, logic, results, readability, ai-tells); a pre-edit hook mechanically enforces the freeze; convergence is self-judged with per-round git history.

plugins.name: experiment-lab-ar
plugins.description: Experiment + section-drafting loop work spec (auto-research phase plugin).
